items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You didn't know John, eh? Yeah, I know him. Yeah.

ctx.x: Ask him who he worked with in that district. What? Ask him who he worked with in the district. What band?
So who did you work with in the district? What bands? John Kazman. Then I worked with that team at the doghouse for about three years and a half.
Yeah, but I mean around the Tuxedo and the 25.
